title: PolicyEvidenceFact
description: Deterministic tool output from get_policy_evidence. Computed entirely by environment/policy_evidence.py by reading existing report JSON files under runs/<run_id>/ that agents #2-4's CLI scripts already write -- no field here is ever produced by an LLM, and this fact does not depend on the task table at all.

n_runs_scanned.description: Runs that had at least one relevant report file present.

n_run_dirs_considered.description: Total run directories examined, including ones with no relevant report at all.
